composer: Write a message… Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line
chat_hint: Start a conversation, select a model, and keep your ideas local.
no_model: No model yet — import a GGUF in Models.
no_conversation: Create or select a conversation first.
delete_conversation: Delete this conversation and its history?
remove_model: Remove this catalog entry? The model file stays on disk.
model_hint: GGUF runs with llama.cpp. Ollama is optional. Import references files without copying them.
model_details: Select a model to see its details.
external_backend_settings: This service is external. Configure model roots and engines on its host.
download_hint: Downloads start only after confirmation. Completed GGUF files can be imported here.
settings_hint: Engine and directory changes restart only the backend owned by this app. Generation defaults apply to new messages. GPU support depends on your engine build.
diagnostics_hint: Live API diagnostics. Logs contain only event codes, never tokens, prompts or raw engine output.
unauthorized: Authentication failed. Supply OMNICORE_DESKTOP_TOKEN for an existing service; authentication stays enabled.
llama_unavailable: llama.cpp is unavailable. Set the llama-server executable in Settings.
backend_process_error: Could not start. Check the installation.
database_incompatible: Could not start: the database version is incompatible. Your data was not deleted.
database_start_error: Could not open the database. Check file access and free space.
backend_exited: The service stopped unexpectedly. Try reconnecting.
model_required: Select a model before sending a message.
path_not_allowed: Directory is not allowed. Add it in Settings on the backend host.
out_of_memory: The model exceeds available memory. Use a smaller model or context.
gpu_unavailable: No working GPU engine/device was found. Use Auto for CPU fallback or check engine diagnostics.
busy: Finish or stop the current generation first.
no_answer: There is no answer to copy yet.
already_running: OmniCore is already using this data directory.
config_error: Cannot read desktop settings. Check desktop.json in your configuration directory.
stream_disconnected: The response stream disconnected. Partial text is kept in history.
ollama_managed: Ollama loads the model on the first message.
invalid_settings: Invalid settings. Check parameters and directory permissions.
invalid_backend_url: Invalid backend URL. Use local HTTP or remote HTTPS.
incompatible_backend: The backend is not compatible with the OmniCore API.
welcome_steps:
1. Import a local GGUF or download one in Models.
2. Configure llama.cpp in Settings when needed. Ollama is optional.
3. Load a compatible model, create a conversation and send a message. Model weights are never bundled.
report_saved: Diagnostic report saved without tokens, paths or conversation content.
report_failed: Cannot save the diagnostic report. Choose a writable location.
unknown_error: Unexpected backend error. Reconnect or check diagnostics.
empty_response: The engine returned no final answer. Check the chat template and finish reason; the context was not increased automatically.
reasoning_limit_reached: The token limit was used for reasoning before a final answer. Disable thinking if the model supports it, or explicitly adjust the answer limit.
context_limit_exceeded: The prompt exceeds the model context. Shorten the conversation or explicitly choose a context supported by the model and available memory.
engine_invalid_response: The inference engine returned an invalid response.
cuda_hint: Keep the CPU engine configured. For GPU set device=auto and GPU layers > 0. Missing GPU/runtime falls back to CPU in auto mode; explicit CUDA0 requires a detected device. Out-of-memory remains an error. CUDA hardware validation is required.
cpu_available: CPU ready. Auto will use CPU if no GPU engine is found.
gpu_offload_unverified: The engine did not confirm moving any layers to GPU. Auto can use CPU; check GPU settings and engine compatibility.
cuda_runtime_unavailable: The CUDA engine cannot load its runtime libraries or driver. Check diagnostics or use Auto/CPU.
gpu_layers_required: Select at least one GPU layer to require CUDA.
author: Author
readme_unavailable: Could not load the model card.
memory_estimate: Estimate: weights require about {size} RAM; full GPU offload needs at least {size} VRAM plus overhead. Context and the engine increase requirements. Check llama.cpp compatibility.
model_import_failed: Model import failed. Use the import button to retry.
context_choose_model: Select a model to set its context.
context_reload: The change applies when the model is restarted.
multipart_gguf_unsupported: This model has multiple parts. Downloading a single part is not supported; choose a complete GGUF file.
regenerate_branch: Regeneration creates a new conversation branch.
regenerate_draft: Send or clear the draft first.
models_empty: No matching models. Import a GGUF or change the filters.
ui_scale_hint: Text and control size in logical units. Screen scaling remains managed by Qt.
transfers_empty:
No active transfers.
Find a model in the Hugging Face tab and choose a file to download.
model_actions: More model actions: unload or remove entry
agent_hint: Requires a model supporting tools or the JSON protocol. File grants expire on backend restart. Writes always need approval.
agent_folder_warning: Allow this conversation to read this folder? Only a local model receives tool results. Writes require separate approval.
agent_sensitive_warning: Also allow hidden files and files whose names suggest credentials? Choose No unless deliberately sharing private configuration. This does not bypass folder boundaries or write approval.
agent_no_diff: Empty file or unchanged contents. Confirm only if intended.
agent_protocol_invalid: Model did not return the required tool protocol. Try JSON mode or another compatible model.
agent_model_error: Model request failed; no tool was inferred from plain text.
agent_context_limit: Agent context budget exhausted; increase context or start a shorter task.
agent_sensitive_file: This file needs explicit permission to access private configuration.
agent_file_conflict: The file changed since the preview. Review a new proposal.
agent_incomplete_response: The model response was incomplete; no tool call was executed.
agent_filesystem_unsupported: Agent file tools require supported descriptor-based filesystem operations (Linux Beta 1).
agent_file_limit: File size or type is not supported by agent text tools.
agent_tool_error: Tool operation failed. No success was confirmed.
agent_response_limit: Model response exceeded the size limit.
agent_atomic_edit_unsupported: This filesystem cannot safely exchange file versions.
agent_approval_expired: This write approval is no longer valid.
agent_mode_required: Select Agent mode before starting a task.
agent_test_warning: Run one bounded compatibility test (up to 30 s)? No files will be accessed.
agent_retry_warning: Start a new attempt? Previous writes and denied targets are protected against automatic replay. New writes still need approval.
agent_write_replay_blocked: Previous write/proposal cannot be automatically repeated. Inspect the file before a new task.
agent_model_unsupported: Compatibility test failed. Retest or explicitly select JSON mode.
agent_call_conflict: Repeated tool call ID has conflicting arguments. Nothing was executed.
refresh_model_confirm: Refresh this file registration? This revalidates the GGUF and resets compatibility status. Settings and conversations are preserved.
updates_hint: Manual check of the latest 100 public releases. No automatic installation.
updates_none: No newer release in this channel.
updates_error: Cannot check updates. Check the connection or try again later.
